Maya: Quick heads-up — Borealis QBR scheduled Thu 10am PT. Need a spend sanity check: token forecast, embedding-heavy routes, and any sudden delta from onboarding. Can FinOps + AMs triage by EOD tomorrow?

Evan: On it. I pulled yesterday's metrics — looks like tokens jumped ~45% last 30d due to an embeddings pilot. I'll post a forecast in a sec.

Tom: Can someone drop the billing snapshot? @BillingBot run usage-snapshot --account borealis --window 30d

BillingBot: Usage snapshot ready: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/borealis/usage-30d.csv — total_tokens=12,300,412, embedding_tokens=7,812,300, est_monthly_spend=$14,200

Ria: Embeds spike makes sense — search-autosuggest tests were enabled in prod cluster last week. We throttled part of it but not all buckets. I'll schedule a short canary to reduce top-k and measure impact.

Evan: Thanks Ria. Tom, can you produce conservative/likely/aggressive forecasts with assumptions so we can show runways in the QBR? I can own the slide.

Tom: Yep. Forecasts (monthly): conservative=9M tokens (~$10.5k), likely=14M (~$16k), aggressive=20M (~$23k). Assumptions: 3% weekly organic growth + embedding experiment at current rate; embedding share=60%.

Maya: Perfect. For the QBR slide I need: 1) current spend vs commit, 2) forecasted runways (conservative/likely/aggressive), 3) top 3 mitigations with expected delta. Can we capture quick bullets now?

Ria: Quick bullets:  - Disable sampling test traffic for prod (est -18%)  - Client-side prefix cache for recent queries (est -22%)  - Shift reranker to a cheaper model variant during peak (est -10%)

Evan: I'll draft the slide and share in #qbr-decks. Any objections to proactively notifying the customer we may throttle experiments if spend exceeds +30% vs commit?

Maya: No objections — flag proactively, include mitigation timeline and impact estimates. I'll own the customer comms. Thanks all :thumbsup:
